description: The Advanced Technology Microwave Sounder (ATMS, serial SN304) on NOAA-21 (JPSS-2). The curves are the measured channel SRFs at +20 C for the primary and redundant LO from NOAA STAR's updated public dataset, converted from frequency to wavelength.
short_description: ATMS microwave sounder on NOAA-21 (JPSS-2): measured channel SRFs
facility_description: The Joint Polar Satellite System (JPSS) is NOAA's polar-orbiting series (Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21, ...).

notes: Dataset 'NOAA-21 ATMS Spectral Response Function (SRF) Dataset (Update)' (J2_ATMS_SRFs_17July2026.zip, listed 10/13/2026); columns 'Frequency (GHz)', 'SRF (dB)'; converted to Angstrom (c/nu) and 10**(dB/10), peak 1. Band names ch<nn>_PRI / ch<nn>_RED. The reference is the S-NPP ATMS overview (heritage instrument). DetectorType energy assumed.
